title: Bar The Red Lion 2: Your Ultimate Destination for Fun and Entertainment in Benidorm
description: Experience a vibrant atmosphere at Bar The Red Lion 2 in Benidorm, where delightful staff, karaoke fun, and unbeatable drink deals come together. Enjoy live football and entertaining tribute acts in a friendly space that’s perfect for laughter and memorab
paragraphs: Bar The Red Lion 2, located on Av. Dr. Severo Ochoa in Benidorm, Alicante, offers an unforgettable experience for both locals and tourists. Known for its vibrant atmosphere, this bar features friendly staff and engaging entertainment, including karaoke and tribute acts. Customers rave about the incredible service, exemplified by the delightful Vicci and her crew, ensuring laughter and memorable nights. With enticing drink deals, like 5 bottles for just 12 euros, Bar The Red Lion 2 is a perfect spot for enjoying sports and socializing. Embrace the lively spirit of Benidorm at this must-visit venue.

Welcome to Bar The Red Lion 2, an iconic venue nestled in the heart of Benidorm, Alicante, where laughter and good times are always on the menu. Located at Av. Dr. Severo Ochoa, 233, this lively bar is more than just a place to grab a drink; it’s an unforgettable experience filled with camaraderie and entertainment.

At Bar The Red Lion 2, the atmosphere is electric. Reviewers rave about the friendly staff, led by the delightful Vicci. From karaoke nights to live tribute acts, there’s never a dull moment. One customer, Donald Sweeting, humorously recounted his night out, where he was even mistaken for a celebrity, enjoying complimentary drinks while belting out tunes with the owner. It perfectly captures the spirit of this fun-loving establishment.

Guests appreciate the bar’s competitive drink deals, such as the fantastic offer of five beers for just 12 euros, making it an ideal stop for football fans and partygoers alike. Christopher Emery highlighted these bucket deals that keep the good times rolling without breaking the bank.

The friendly vibe and welcoming staff have left a lasting impression on visitors. Andrew McHattie shared that his visits revealed no hidden issues—just a great time filled with laughter and good service. Meanwhile, Richard Weir noted the sheer joy and entertainment value of embracing the unique charm of Benidorm, stating it’s a place everyone should experience at least once. The bar caters to a diverse crowd, ensuring there is truly something for everyone.
headings: Welcome To Bar The Red Lion 2
